lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid consisting of approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. Spacing between centroids is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with roughly 10-12 clusters visible per horizontal row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, with high-luminance centroids situated precisely at these vertical-horizontal intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct shadow gradient (high luminance on the dorsal side, low luminance on the ventral side) consistent with a structural ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin in the lower-left quadrant shows a localized high density of smaller, high-luminance spots that are distinct from the larger grid-pattern blobs on the flank.
